subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: How one simple fix turned a frustrated pup parent into a weight-loss hero for their dog.
body_paragraphs: At 2AM, Sarah found herself staring at her phone, tears streaming down her face. Her 8-year-old Beagle, Max, couldn't even finish a 5-minute walk without collapsing. She'd tried every diet, every 'vet-approved' plan, but nothing worked. Until she stumbled on a tiny, hidden feature in our app that literally changed Max's life.

That feature is the calorie calculator for treats and meals. Sarah realized she'd been overfeeding Max by 300 calories a day just in 'healthy' treats. One click to log his daily snacks, and she saw the truth: those 'low-fat' biscuits were packing 80 calories each. She switched to carrot sticks, and Max dropped 4 pounds in 3 weeks.

You already have this feature in PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan. It's buried in the meal plan tab — tap 'Treat Log' and start tracking. No judgment, just data. See exactly where those extra calories are hiding, and reclaim your dog's energy.
Open the app now and log one treat. Just one. See what happens. P.S. Sarah says Max now does a full mile walk every morning, tail wagging the whole way. Your dog deserves that too.
